## What this case checks

Ensure GeometryCollection features can be indexed and loaded without being coerced into a single geometry family.

## Risk types covered

- [`mixed_geometry_output`](../risk/mixed-geometry-output.md)

## Expected behavior

| Assertion | Expected |
|---|---|
| `expect_loadable` | yes |
| `expect_valid_geometry` | yes |
| `expect_crs` | yes |
| `expected_epsg` | `4326` |
| `expected_geometry_types` | `GeometryCollection` |
